questionText:
Consider the following C functions.

The value returned by $\text{pp}(3, 4)$ is ________.
explanation:
Step 1: Execution of tob(4, arr)
The function tob stores the binary representation of $b = 4$ in array arr in LSB-first order and returns the total number of bits.

• $i = 0$: $b = 4 \implies b \% 2 = 0$, so $arr[0] = 0$. $b = 4/2 = 2$.
• $i = 1$: $b = 2 \implies b \% 2 = 0$, so $arr[1] = 0$. $b = 2/2 = 1$.
• $i = 2$: $b = 1 \implies b \% 2 = 1$, so $arr[2] = 1$. $b = 1/2 = 0$.

The loop ends when $b = 0$. Function returns $i = 3$, so $len = 3$ and $arr = [0, 0, 1]$.

Step 2: Execution of pp(3, 4)
Initial values: $ex = a = 3$, $tot = 1$, $len = 3$.

• For $i = 0$: $arr[0] = 0$, $tot$ remains $1$. $ex = 3 \times 3 = 9$.
• For $i = 1$: $arr[1] = 0$, $tot$ remains $1$. $ex = 9 \times 9 = 81$.
• For $i = 2$: $arr[2] = 1$, $tot = tot \times ex = 1 \times 81 = 81$. $ex = 81 \times 81 = 6561$.

The function returns $tot = 81$.
